bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDO has issuer-native deployments on Ethereum, Base, and BNB Smart Chain, with Chainlink CCIP BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1 providing burn/mint transfer machinery across those native deployments and a provisional authored Plasma route. The Ethereum, Base, and BNB pools share issuer EOA owner 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88; the Plasma pool has a separate owner and failure domain. CCIP token pools, peer/source-pool configuration, rate limits, and administrators are scored here rather than as native Mint Authority. The Plasma/Kaia identity remains unresolved, so the authored Plasma route is retained unchanged pending authoritative mapping.

The Ethereum CCIP BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1 is a conserved bridge return path and is assessed in structured Bridge Risk controls, not as native Mint Authority.

Issuer EOA 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88 holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, and UPGRADE_ROLE at the current role-read blocks; the local CCIP BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1 remains bridge machinery reviewed in structured controls and does not change native issuance classification.

On-chain 2026-07-20: full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history (Plasma routescan) shows the sole current MINTER_ROLE/BURNER_ROLE member is the Chainlink CCIP pool 0x017566Aad2c164011b9C6552Df3EB7a8C5c11590 (typeAndVersion 'USDO BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1'); deployer 0x414250b3ac7a46e9baa1ad6dfc41200e5329eece had its roles revoked, leaving admin EOA 0xc4109e427a149239e6c1e35bb2ecd0015b6500b8. controls.label: USDO Ethereum BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The USDO BurnMintTokenPool source exposes supported-chain and remote-pool configuration; exact current per-lane remote mappings were not independently enumerated at the observation block.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The CCIP pool exposes inbound and outbound rate-limit administration; the shared owner EOA can change the configured bridge bounds.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Pool owner() is issuer EOA 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88. The same token-level MINTER_ROLE is bridge-only here and does not create an independent native issuer path.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Chainlink CCT burn/mint semantics validate the cross-chain message and source-pool path, then mint or release the destination amount against source burn/lock accounting; this is bridge machinery rather than independent native issuance.

controls.capDescription: The pool performs CCIP burn/mint and exposes owner-controlled peer and rate-limit configuration; its token MINTER_ROLE is a conserved bridge return path.
bypassSurfaces: The shared issuer EOA can administer the CCIP pool and its rate limits; direct native minting is separately scoped to Mint Authority.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770537, pool 0x500d4882938020e939a5666c1b4200873da7efd3 reports owner 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88, typeAndVersion USDO BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1, and local token 0x8238884ec9668ef77b90c6dff4d1a9f4f4823bfe. The pool's MINTER_ROLE read at block 25770585 is a CCIP bridge role; it is not counted as native issuer authority.

controls.label: USDO Ethereum/Base/BNB shared CCIP pool owner EOA

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The same EOA owns the Ethereum, Base, and BNB USDO pools; each pool exposes supported-chain and remote-pool configuration, while exact current per-lane mappings were not independently enumerated.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The shared EOA can administer inbound and outbound CCIP rate-limit configuration on the three pools and can widen or remove the configured bridge bounds.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Current pool reads at Ethereum block 25770537, Base block 50064496, and BNB block 116350256 return the same owner EOA; eth_getCode on the Ethereum owner returned 0x.

controls.capDescription: A single issuer EOA is both the native minter/upgrader and common owner of the Ethereum, Base, and BNB CCIP pools; its bridge administration is scored separately from native minting.
bypassSurfaces: The shared issuer EOA is a common-mode bridge failure domain across three native deployments; CCIP message, source-pool, and burn/mint accounting checks remain route invariants.
controls.evidence: Current pool reads on 2026-08-16 identify owner 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88 at Ethereum block 25770537, Base block 50064496, and BNB block 116350256. The owner is an EOA on Ethereum and its pool powers are bridge administration, peer/configuration, and rate-limit control; its native role powers remain separately represented in Mint Authority.
